description: Use this when someone asks how much concrete they need for a slab, footing, post holes or steps, or how many bags to buy. Calculates the concrete for a slab (length × width × thickness, or area × thickness), a footing (length × width × depth), round columns, piers or post holes (π × (diameter ÷ 2)² × height, less the post that stands in each hole), or solid steps (each step filled down to the ground, the top step being the landing), times a count, plus waste (10 % when not given; NRMCA advises 4 to 10 %). Returns the volume in liters without and with waste, the total in cubic feet and cubic yards (1 cu yd = 764.555 l), the bags of premixed concrete that make the total, by size (lb40, lb60 and lb80: Quikrete bags that make 0.30, 0.45 and 0.60 cu ft; kg20: 10 l, as Blue Circle states; kg25 and kg40: 12.5 and 20 l, as Sievert states), the bags of another product when bagWeight and bagYield are given (bag: count and weight in kilograms), the site mix when mix or all mix fields are given (mix: whole bags of cement and their weight, the sand, stone and water for them in liters, the measure in liters, and the measures of sand, stone and water for each bag), whether the total reaches readyMixLeast (1 cu yd unless given, as ready-mix plants usually deliver no less), and the fewest and the most truckloads at truckMin to truckMax (8 to 12 cu yd unless given).

area.description: Area of a slab in square meters, used instead of length and width.

bagWeight.description: Weight in kilograms of a bag of premixed concrete other than the listed ones, such as 35; needs bagYield.

bagYield.description: Fresh concrete from that bag in liters, as printed on it, such as 17.5 for a 35 kg bag.

count.description: Number of equal slabs, footings, columns or holes, or stairs; 1 when left out.

diameter.description: Diameter of a round column or hole, in millimeters.

height.description: Height of a column, or depth of a hole, in millimeters.

landing.description: Depth of the top step where it is a landing; the tread depth when left out, in millimeters.

length.description: Length of a slab or a footing, in millimeters.

mix.description: A named mix for concrete mixed on site from 50 kg bags of cement, with sand, stone and water measured in cans of 18 l (ABCP, Brazil); per bag: lean (concreto magro, base of footings and under floors) 8.5 sand, 11.5 stone, 2 water, makes 250 l; footing (fundações) 5, 6.5, 1.5, 160 l; floor (pisos) 4, 6, 1.5, 140 l; structural (pilares, vigas, lajes) 4, 5.5, 1.25, 140 l. The mix fields replace its parts.

mixBag.description: Weight in kilograms of the bag of cement for a site mix, such as 35 in France or 25 in Spain; with the other mix fields it defines a mix without mix.

mixMeasure.description: Volume in liters of the can or bucket that measures the sand and stone, such as 10 for the French bucket.

mixSand.description: Measures of sand for one bag of cement.

mixStone.description: Measures of gravel or crushed stone for one bag of cement.

mixWater.description: Water in liters for one bag of cement.

mixYield.description: Concrete in liters that one bag of cement makes. Lafarge and Vicat, per 35 kg bag in 10 l buckets: 350 kg/m³, 5 sand, 8 gravel, 17 l water, 100 l; Lafarge 400 kg/m³ for reinforced concrete: 4, 7, 17 l, 90 l.

post.description: Side of a square post, or diameter of a round one, that stands in each hole and takes the place of concrete; a US 4×4 post is 88.9, in millimeters.

postShape.description: Shape of the post; square when left out.

readyMixLeast.description: The least amount a ready-mix plant delivers, in liters; 764.555 (1 cu yd) when left out, such as 1000 in Germany.

rise.description: Height of each step, in millimeters.

run.description: Depth of each tread, in millimeters.

shape.description: slab (length and width, or area, and thickness), footing (length, width and thickness, which is its depth), column (a round column, pier or post hole: diameter and height), steps (solid steps: steps, rise, run and width).

steps.description: Number of steps, with the top one, which is the landing.

thickness.description: Thickness of a slab, or depth of a footing, in millimeters.

truckMax.description: The largest load of a truck mixer, in liters; 9175 (12 cu yd) when left out, such as 9000 in Germany.

truckMin.description: The smallest load of a truck mixer, in liters; 6116 (8 cu yd) when left out, such as 6000 in Germany.

waste.description: Percent added for waste; 10 when left out.

width.description: Width of a slab, a footing or steps, in millimeters.
